what: Bring your own CSV, own a verified model. A generic, client-side tool: it infers a CSV's columns, auto-encodes them, forges the patterns that predict a binary target on held-out rows, and mints the winner as a real downloadable owned model + a signed, re-checkable receipt. Proven here on a real 7,043-row dataset the tool was NOT hand-coded for.

claims.text: With ZERO hand-coding, the generic tool recovers the real churn driver on held-out rows
It parsed and auto-encoded the raw file itself: 7,043 rows → 46 features, target auto-picked
Many patterns clear the held-out bar (richer than a hand-built 6-feature model)
THE PRODUCT: the downloaded owned-model module imports and predicts correctly, its receipt verifies, and a tampered receipt is rejected
claims.check: modelPredictsMonthToMonth === 'Yes' && modelPredictsTwoYear === 'No' && modelReceiptVerifies === true && tamperRejected === true

claims.text: The model mints tiny and OWNED, and owning beats renting an LLM to score rows
